continuation.end: Gorgon says he has not tasted Alden’s blood. He warns Alden does not understand the offer, denies they can properly be friends, but says he is fond of him and wishes him well. He warns of side effects he cannot classify. Alden privately recognizes that the gaze erased his former doubt; he feels Gorgon is fundamentally benevolent. Stop before explicit renewed permission or any drinking.
continuation.note: Explicit permission, blood already placed in salsa, Gorgon drinks with no spectacle, and Alden asks about taste; stop before next plans.
